name: pixel-agents-multi
description: Pixel art control room for Claude Code and Codex agents

pixel-agents-multi.codex.discoverAllCwds.description: When enabled, Pixel Agents Multi adopts recent external Codex threads across all cwd values, not just cwd values matching the current VS Code workspace or an existing user-spawned agent.

pixel-agents-multi.codex.commandPath.description: Command or executable path used to launch Codex handoff executors. On Windows, Pixel Agents Multi also checks the local OpenAI Codex app install when the command is not on VS Code's PATH.

pixel-agents-multi.claude.showChatSessio.description: When enabled, Pixel Agents Multi adopts Claude chat-mode sessions in addition to code and cowork. Off by default to reduce noise from non-working conversations.

pixel-agents-multi.claude.commandPath.description: Command or executable path used to launch Claude Code. The Claude VS Code extension alone is not enough; Pixel Agents Multi needs the Claude Code CLI.

commands.title: Pixel Agents Multi: Export Layout as Default

scripts.compile: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js && npm run build:webview
scripts.package: npm run check-types && npm run lint && node esbuild.js --production && npm run build:webview
scripts.lint: eslint src server shared && cd webview-ui && eslint .
scripts.lint:fix: eslint src server shared --fix && cd webview-ui && eslint . --fix
scripts.test: npm run test:webview && npm run test:server
scripts.verify:release: npm run verify:identity && npm run verify:vsix && npm run verify:installed
scripts.release:local: npm run build && npm run verify:identity && npm run verify:vsix && npm run package:vsix && npm run install:local && npm run verify:installed
